note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 Honda Civic Factory Service Manual (96-00), First Edition 8/99. It holds the 6th generation Civic 4 door Sedan as a wheeled civilian-car lead. The manual publishes the identity, overall dimensions, wheelbase, track, ground clearance, per-variant gross vehicle weight ratings, the engine family and displacement and the transmission types. It publishes no curb weight, no operating weight, no payload, no engine rated power, no engine torque and no tyre size or pressure, so the entry is not runtime-ready and emits no runtime row. The Design Specifications table sits on scan PDF page 64 (printed page 3-20). The page image resolves the track row: it prints 1,475/1,475 mm and 58.1/58.1 in, while the PDF text layer misreads the rear as 1,415 mm. The printed values agree, so no conflict record is created.
